name: standing towel foot crunch
description: A foot exercise where you scrunch a towel on the floor with your toes. It strengthens the muscles of the foot and arch.
instructions: Stand with one foot flat on a towel laid on a smooth floor.
Curl your toes to pull the towel toward you.
Release and repeat until the towel is bunched under your foot.
Hold on to a support if you need balance.
Do your reps, then switch feet.
